content.short: Tonkey is a TON multisig wallet for teams and institutions that need shared transaction approval.
content.description: Tonkey is a multi-signature wallet product from TONX for the TON ecosystem. TONX describes Tonkey as an institutional TON routing wallet and notes that its multisig wallet has secured significant ecosystem assets. It is intended for shared custody, treasury operations, and approval workflows where multiple signers must authorize transactions. Tonkey belongs with wallets because the main job is custody, account access, transfers, signing, dapp connection, or asset management. Tonkey is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
